entries.name: down
entries.prompt:
Convert the approved character in the input concept sheet into an actual transparent pixel-art GAME ANIMATION SPRITESHEET. Output ONLY the sprite sheet, no parchment, no labels, no text, no borders, no shadows, no UI. Exact layout: portrait 1024x1536 image divided into FOUR equal columns and SIX equal rows of 256x256 transparent cells (24 frames). Do not draw the grid. True RGBA transparent empty background, NOT a checkerboard painted into the image, no white or black matte. Hero is St. Knihor: identical bald clean-shaven dark-brown-skinned Black male paladin, silver plate with restrained gold trim, ivory tabard, short royal-blue cape, blue steel shield with gold sun emblem in left hand, stubby one-handed steel-and-gold hammer in right. No helmet, no hair, no crown. Tiny Swords compatible compact chibi proportions, large bald head, short legs, crisp low resolution pixel clusters, dark navy outline, no antialiasing or painted detail. EVERY FRAME FACES DOWN toward viewer in the same front three-quarter direction as the large approved concept pose. Keep exact same character design, proportions and equipment from reference in all 24 frames. Underlying character approximately 64x80 logical pixels. Sprite stands centered horizontally with feet baseline at local y220 and x128 in EVERY cell, usual top of head at local y58, full body about162px tall in the 256 cell; leave generous transparent margin for weapon arcs. No part crosses cell boundaries. All same scale. Animate from left to right, NEVER different camera angles within a row.
Row1 (top, cells0–3) IDLE: four extremely subtle breathing poses, steady feet, shield/hammer gently lift then settle, smooth loop.
Row2 WALK: left foot forward, contact midpoint, right foot forward, contact midpoint; arms and cape counter-move, body stays centered.
Row3 HAMMER ATTACK: guarded ready; hammer lifted beside/above shoulder; powerful downward-forward strike with hammer low; recover to ready. Exact impact in THIRD frame. No bright effect baked into body.
Row4 CAST: neutral ready; raises hammer in blessing; holds hammer raised and shield forward; lowers it back. Small gesture, no visual magic baked in.
Row5 HIT: normal braced; slight backward recoil; shield braced close; recover upright. Never lose equipment.
Row6 FALL: unsteady upright; drops to one knee; leans down; lying/fallen compact pose on ground with shield and hammer still visible. Non-gory. Keep ground location in same lower area within cell.
Render all24 clear, separate, correctly aligned frames, not variations of a concept pose. Only this one character; no companion units or ability icons. Maintain game-ready transparency.

entries.name: side
entries.prompt:
Create the RIGHT-FACING companion spritesheet to input image1 (St.Knihor approved front animation atlas). This is a precise camera-direction edit: EXACTLY the same character, armor, bald dark brown head, gold-trimmed silver plate, blue cloak, sun shield and steel onehand hammer, SAME 4columns x6rows and same animation sequence, but turn EVERY POSE to the RIGHT, a consistent SIDE three-quarter view showing his face looking right. Character must be clean-shaven bald Black male, not wearinghelmet. Portrait1024x1536,24equal256cells, no grid. TRUE RGBA TRANSPARENT background; empty margins alpha0. Do not paintcheckerboard or darkbackdrop. Output spritesonly, nolabels/noicons/nolettering. Keep pixel-art lowresolution crisp TinySwords chibi proportion, bodyapprox170px tall in256cell, groundbaseline y220, trunkcenter x128, entireweaponinsidecell. Very important consistentbody size and worldpivot acrossframes. Hammer in right hand, shieldleft consistent anatomical hands; show equipment plausibly in sideview. Do not redrawfrontviews. Same six rows:
row1 four subtle idlebreathing frames, slightcape motion, nojump.
row2 four walking frames, alternatefeetleft/contact/right/contact, facingright, do notprogressacrosscell.
row3 meleehammer ready, winduphammerraised, strikeforwardrightanddown (THIRDframeimpact), recover.
row4 holycast ready, raisinghammer, holdhammerup, returnready, nobakedeffects.
row5 gettinghit ready, recoilback, shieldbrace, recover.
row6 collapse uprightunsteady, oneknee, fallingover, lyingontheground, nongory, hammer/shieldvisible.
24distinct coherent animationposes, organized correctly4perrow. Don't add any background shadows or glows. Keep all details faithful to inputhero.

entries.name: up
entries.prompt:
Create the BACK-FACING UP/NORTH companion sprite animation atlas from the input St.Knihor frontatlas. Camera is fixed elevatedthreequarter topdownlikeTinySwords. EVERY frame faces AWAY fromviewer, upward into battlefield, rear of bald darkbrown head, back of royalbluecape prominentlyvisible. Sameexact bald clean-shaven Blackmale paladin, stockycompactbody, silverarmor goldtrim, bluecape, shieldleft hand andonehandhammer right. NO face shownexceptsmall ear/sidecontour; NOTfrontposes. Preserve sprite pixelartstyle/proportions/equipment from reference. This is game-ready transparent sprite art, no backdrop, true alpha0 emptybackground, no shadows, no texture, no checkerboard. Output portrait1024x1536 in exact4columns x6rows =24cells256x256, no borders orlabels. Feetlocalbaseline y220,trunkcenterx128,usualheadtop y58,constantbodysize,roomforraisedhammer,no celloverlap. FOUR consecutive frames perrow in this order:
Row1 idle subtlebreathing, steadyfeet, bluecape tinyshift; allviewedfrombehind.
Row2 walkupwards in place alternatingfeet, cape sways, no motion acrosscells.
Row3 hammerattack to enemyinfront/up: ready, raisedhammerabove rightshoulder, downward strike forward awayfromviewer (impactframe3), recover.
Row4 cast blessing: ready, lift hammer, hold abovehead, returnready; no bakedmagic.
Row5 hit: bracedready, recoil, crouchedshieldbrace, recover.
Row6 fall: stagger, kneel, collapse forward awayfromviewer, fallenon ground showingbluecape/back with hammer/shieldat sides, nongory.
Maintainsameanatomicalhandsanddrawvisiblegearconsistentwithrearview. Distinct4step animations,24frames,nonloopfallenlastpose. Crisp lowresolutionpixelclustersanddarkoutline,no photorealism.
